_readme: Generated by src/08_key_numbers.py from outputs/eda, outputs/models, outputs/sim, outputs/valuemap, outputs/critic. Do not edit by hand. Points are Wine Enthusiast scores (80-100); prices in USD; *_pct = percent; *_pctp = percentage points.

data.split_method: GroupShuffleSplit by normalized title, 80/20 outer (test) then 80/20 inner (valid)

ladder.label: Ridge: meta only (country, province, variety, vintage)
ElasticNet: meta + log_price (alpha x l1_ratio on valid)
(Experiment) XGBoost: meta + log_price + winery OOF target encoding
(Aux, post-review) Ridge: TF-IDF(description) only, no meta/price

models.main_model_rule: lowest valid MAE among ladder models 2-6 (pre-review features only)

winery_experiment.encoding: smoothed mean points per winery (m=20), 5-fold out-of-fold inside the fitting data, folds grouped by title_norm; unseen -> global mean
winery_experiment.note: Main model stays pre-review product info only (country/province/variety/price/vintage) by design; the winery model is reported as an experiment regardless of the result.

xgb_reg_score.label: Reference: xgb_meta_price regressor predicted points as score (no refit)

notes.xgb_clf: n_estimators by early stopping on valid log loss -> valid scores slightly optimistic
notes.xgb_reg_score: pred_xgb_meta_price from P2 (regressor of points, not refit)

regularization.design: same one-hot + standardized design as Ridge(meta+price); hyperparameters chosen on valid MAE; zero counts from the final train+valid fit

sparse_vs_ridge_valid.note: Ridge(meta+price) remains the linear model used in the simulation; a 'clearly better' flag is reported for a human decision, never applied automatically

shap.top_bottom_rule: top lists contain only positive effects, bottom lists only negative ones (may hold < 5)

text_aux_model.note: description is written by the critic who gave the score -> post-review, auxiliary analysis only; never used in the simulation

simulation.ci_note: Markets are re-sampled from one fixed test pool; the CI reflects market-sampling variability only, not uncertainty about the wider wine population or a different test sample.

value_map.definition: residual = actual points - price-only Ridge prediction (fit on train+valid), test rows
value_map.top_bottom_rule: top lists contain only positive residuals, bottom lists only negative ones
value_map.under20_rank_rule: main-model predicted points desc, then price asc, then title asc; one row per title_norm; actual points not used for ranking

under20_top5.title: Winzer Krems 2016 Kremser Goldberg Kellermeister Privat Grüner Veltliner (Kremstal)

critic_check.critic_note: country effects in Wine Enthusiast scores are largely confounded with which critic reviews the country; within-critic premium = country residual minus the same critics' own average over their other countries (leave-one-out; test rows, cells with >= cell_min_n rows)
critic_check.critic_ci_note: row-bootstrap CI over test rows; ignores critic-level uncertainty (only 1-2 critics per country) and critic x country interaction, so it is too narrow for a 'controlled for critic' claim
critic_check.critic_multi_country_critics: Anna Lee C. Iijima; Anne Krebiehl MW; Joe Czerwinski; Lauren Buzzeo; Michael Schachner; Roger Voss; Susan Kostrzewa
critic_check.critic_germany_within_critic_critics: Anna Lee C. Iijima; Joe Czerwinski

stats._note: Classical inference on train+valid (n rows above). HC3 robust SEs. p-values printed as 0.0 are below float precision (< 1e-300). With n ~ 89k, significance is expected; effect size and R² carry the meaning.

ols_full.formula: points ~ log_price + vintage_c + vintage_missing + C(country) + C(province) + C(variety)
ols_full.collinearity_note: province is nested in country, so category dummies are not separately identified (huge condition number, rank-deficient design). R², F and the nested F-test are valid; individual category coefficients / p-values are not interpreted.

overfit._note: train/valid = chosen config fit on train only; trval_fit/test = final model refit on train+valid. XGB n_estimators were picked by early stopping on valid, so its valid score is slightly optimistic.

collinearity._note: Same hyperparameters as the main run, no re-tuning. Multicollinearity affects how credit is split between country and province, not how well the model predicts.
